initialize.instructions: ArtForge AI MCP. For a new design call artforge_create_design once with the user prompt, the exact texts and width/height: it detects the design type (text, poster, card, table, ruled page, interior scene, character, landscape, architecture, reference image), plans, draws, saves, exports, runs pixel QA, verifies text/size/elements and returns the preview image. Pass tables as table={columns, rows} and long structured text as blocks or body; never draw cells, lines or scenes element by element. Report verification issues, QA warnings, design.missing and design.limits to the user. Binding operating skills: read artforge_tool_docs guide="operating-procedure" first (tools, skill and reference map); Before composing a card, ad, banner, poster, logo, magazine, lesson, infographic or vector colour blend, call artforge_tool_docs route="<user request>". Apply the selected briefs and read other relevant guides by ID (guide="list" for all). Palettes, styleguides and the 25 page-grounded book rules are applied inside artforge_create_design and reported in evidence; do not search them before it. Use artforge_tool_op (op "batch" for several edits) only for small follow-up edits; batch returns the updated preview, so export again only when a separate format or scale is requested.

tools.name: artforge_capabilities
tools.title: ArtForge AI MCP capabilities
tools.description: Report the three components (routing engine, references, drawing tool), the design skills, reference index counts, whether the drawing tool HTTP API is reachable and the available low-level operations. Call this first.

tools.name: artforge_plan_design
tools.title: Plan a design (phases ① ② ③)
tools.description: Analyse a design request, pick the design skill, resolve which reference palettes (1-3) and which single styleguide apply, extract their real colours, choose Arabic typography and return an ordered operation plan with phases ①→⑤. Only needed to inspect a plan before drawing; for a new design prefer artforge_create_design (one call). Supply text explicitly to control the copy. For model-authored scenes pass sceneSpec; read guide=model-drawing first.

sceneSpec.description: Model-authored geometry. Read guide=model-drawing and exact operation docs. Coordinates are canvas pixels; colour tokens bind selected reference roles: $color.accent/background/backgroundAlt/secondary/text. No file/network operations.

headline.description: Exact headline text (drawn verbatim, max 300 chars); omit to derive it from the prompt.

body.description: Exact body text (drawn verbatim, max 2000 chars).

kicker.description: Exact eyebrow/kicker text (drawn verbatim, max 200 chars).

width.description: Canvas width in px (defaults to the skill canvas).

skillId.description: TEXT layout template only (poster, social-square, story, banner, card, cover, invitation). Do not pass it for drawings: it is ignored for people, scenes, landscapes, buildings, tables and ruled pages.

palettes.description: How many reference palettes to use: 1-3 (default 1: one coherent colour layer chosen by the request’s mood and subject).

books.description: Force specific knowledge book ids (see artforge_book_knowledge) instead of automatic selection.

knowledgeConcepts.description: How many page-bound concepts to return: 1-12 (default 5).

designType.description: Force the design type. Omit to let ArtForge detect it from the prompt (a room/landscape/building request is DRAWN, not turned into a text card).

elements.description: Visual elements that must appear (e.g. ["bookshelf","tv","person"]). Merged with elements detected in the prompt; any element ArtForge cannot draw is reported, never faked.

abstractStyle.description: Abstract art style (designType abstract): geometric = Bauhaus discs/arcs/lines, clay = soft 3D tiles/pills/spheres, fluid = silk ribbons and smoke, splash = glossy paint splashes, ornamental = decorative bloom/phoenix built on an eye path with varied curves (guide ornamental-composition). Detected from the prompt when omitted.

ornamentSubject.description: Ornamental subject: bloom (flower of plumes over waves) or phoenix. Detected from the prompt when omitted.

ornamentPass.description: Ornamental pass: value = one-hue value study to judge movement, curve variety and interlace before colour; color (default) = same geometry in colour. Reuse the same prompt and seed for both passes.

style.description: Rendering style; painterly uses brush strokes and soft blending.

table.description: Structured table: {columns:[{title, format:text|number|currency|percent|date, align, decimals, currency}], rows:[[...] | {kind:data|subtotal|total|section, cells:[value | {text, colspan}]}], theme?, digits?: "latin"|"arabic-indic"}. Laid out automatically (auto widths, zebra rows, totals, RTL, pagination with repeated header).

blocks.description: Long structured text for ruled/educational pages: [{type:"heading", level:1-3, text, colon?}, {type:"paragraph", text}, {type:"list", ordered, items:[...]}, {type:"table", columns, rows}]. Alternative: put the text in body using "# " headings, "1-" numbered and "-" bullet lines.

ruled.description: true, or {fontSize, spacing, lineColor, marginColor, margin:false} for writing on ruled paper (baselines snapped to the rules, pixel-verified).

referenceImage.description: Absolute path to a user-provided image to build the design on (colours and calm region are analysed from its pixels).

useReferences.description: Default true. false disables the reference palettes and the book rules (used for A/B comparison).

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible procedural details (books, stars, brush grain).

engine.description: auto (default): pictures with spatial relations, several instances, or elements the composer cannot draw are placed by the scene graph while keeping the composer rendering (hybrid; pure scene-graph when the merge cannot guarantee the request); simple requests keep the composer. composer / hybrid / scene-graph force one engine. Read guide=scene-graph.

focal.description: Element id of the focal subject.

anatomy.description: Opt into articulated FK/IK anatomy; legacy remains default for compatibility.

viewpoint.description: Camera viewpoint (detected from the prompt when omitted).

review.description: Visual review for engine scene-graph: {correct: false} to report only, maxRounds 0-3 (default 2).

tools.name: artforge_create_design
tools.title: Create a design in one call (plan + draw + save + export)
tools.description: ONE call is enough for any new picture or design: put the user’s own words in prompt (do not shorten or rephrase them), plus exact texts, width/height and data. Do not search books or references first and do not pass skillId for drawings: book rules, palettes and appearance (clothes colours, hair, smile, setting) are applied automatically and reported in evidence. Runs every phase: intent analysis (text, poster, card, table, ruled page, interior scene, character, landscape, architecture, abstract art: geometric/clay/fluid/splash, reference image), ONE reference colour palette chosen automatically by the request mood and subject (adherence measured on the pixels), book rules, drawing, save, export, pixel QA and verification (canvas size, every text verbatim, flowed words, table rows, requested elements). Returns planId, documentId, the exported file(s) and a preview image. Pass the exact texts, exact width/height, and structured data (table / blocks) instead of drawing cells or lines by hand. For custom compositions (infographics, UI cards, diagrams, posters with your own layout) pass the WHOLE layout as sceneSpec in this one call (up to 1200 operations, guide=model-drawing) instead of drawing shape by shape. Execution and structural checks are reported separately from visual review. Edits: send ALL changes in ONE artforge_tool_op call with op:"batch", params:{documentId, ops:[{op, params}, ...]}; the reply carries the updated preview. One edit per call costs ~4 s each through ChatGPT.

tools.name: artforge_get_reference
tools.title: Read design references
tools.description: List or read the indexed references: palettes (extracted colours), styleguides (tone/aspect metrics), theory books (paths) and the mandatory instruction rules. Originals are preserved and never modified; no reference content is copied into designs.

id.description: Exact reference id; omit to list the collection.

tools.name: artforge_tool_docs
tools.title: Read the drawing tool documentation
tools.description: Search the tool documentation (docs/) for how to call drawing operations: parameters, outputs, saving/exporting, limits and errors. Pass guide to read the binding agent skills (start with guide="operating-procedure"; guide="list" lists them). Pass route with the user request to get only the skills that task needs, ordered, within a context budget.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "draw.text arabic wrap" or "export image".

sectionId.description: Exact section id returned by a previous search.

operations.description: Operation names to fetch exact signatures for.

guide.description: Read a registered ArtForge guide. Use list for the current catalogue.

route.description: The user request: returns ordered guides and the selected layout/colour guidance without planning.

tools.name: artforge_book_knowledge
tools.title: Query the nine design books (page-verified knowledge)
tools.description: Browse the book knowledge (research only). NOT needed before drawing: artforge_create_design already applies the book rules and reports them in evidence. Search the knowledge index built from the nine design books: page-bound concepts with their book, page, category, short quote and verification state (embedded text / OCR / caption / table of contents), plus which ArtForge operations can actually express each concept. Actions: coverage, books, search, page. Knowledge is guidance only — book text and artwork are never copied into designs.

previewPage.description: For action=page only: render a bounded preview of the hash-verified original book page, reference-only.

retrievalMode.description: Optional local search: keyword default; hybrid-fts5 uses BM25/RRF; hybrid-local-lsa adds corpus-only latent semantic vectors, without a neural model.

query.description: Design query or concept, e.g. "reflected light" or "تشريح الشخصية".

bookId.description: Restrict to one book id (see action=books).

books.description: Restrict search to these book ids.

tools.name: artforge_execute_design
tools.title: Execute the plan (phases ④ ⑤)
tools.description: Run a plan created by artforge_plan_design through the drawing tool: create the document, draw every element with the real operations, add the animation, save the editable design, export an image and return an authoritative PNG preview. planId is required; pass the requestId from artforge_plan_design too so a mismatched plan is rejected.

requestId.description: Request id returned by planning; when provided it must match the plan.

requestHash.description: Request hash returned by planning; when provided it must match the plan.

documentId.description: Optional existing document id to draw into instead of creating one.

preview.description: Set false to skip the PNG preview image.

tools.name: artforge_tool_op
tools.title: Call any drawing tool operation
tools.description: Draw or edit a demo document with the documented primitive operations, optionally in a batch. Read document info or preview. Host-file operations and custom providers are unavailable. Public draw-then-generate: use generation.jobs.submit with params {version:1,operationId,prompt,width:512,height:512,documentId}; the actual owned drawing is passed to FLUX, then poll generation.jobs.get with jobId. generation.status reports public capabilities.

op.description: Operation name, e.g. object.update, or "batch" for many operations in one call.

params.description: Operation parameters (documentId is required for document operations). For batch: {documentId, ops:[{op, params}], preview?: true, previewWidth?}.

ops.description: Shortcut for a batch: [{op, params}, …] applied to params.documentId in one call.

tools.name: artforge_export
tools.title: Export an existing design
tools.description: Export a demo document to PNG, JPEG or WebP and return a preview.

preview.description: Set false to skip the PNG preview image.

tools.name: artforge_status
tools.title: Runtime status
tools.description: Report engine state: reference index, plans/runs on disk, drawing tool reachability and stored documents.

tools.name: artforge_artifacts
tools.title: Manage exported artifacts
tools.description: List/get metadata or remove bounded exported resources. Removal deletes only resource copy. Retention7days, max64 entries,8MiB each.

resourceTemplates.name: artforge-export
resourceTemplates.description: Bounded persisted export artifact; use an ID returned by artforge_export.
